## Replications of prior findings

Where our measurements reproduce (or fail to reproduce) a published finding. 'Conceptual' means the same question asked with a different measure, so agreement is weaker evidence than a direct replication.

| id | prior finding | source | kind | our measurement (recomputed) | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R-a | Intermediate layers often give better embeddings than the last layer | Skean et al. 2025 | conceptual (retrieval p@10 instead of their task suite) | best layer is not the last in 10/11 held-out pairs; last-layer regret 3.4 points on average | replicated |
| R-b | Layers settle bottom-up during training | Raghu et al. 2017; Chen et al. 2023 (layer convergence bias) | conceptual (partition agreement with the final checkpoint) | settle step vs depth: rho 0.27 [-0.17, 0.66], 0.46 [0.0, 0.82] | not replicated as stated: ends first, middle last; consistent with Skean et al. 2025 (middle layers change most) |
| R-c | Smaller Pythia models converge less stably | Diehl Martinez et al. 2024 | conceptual | stable layer choice at 4/9 checkpoints (410m) vs 8/9 (1.4b) | consistent (weak: two sizes) |
| R-d | Corresponding layers of different LLMs sit at similar relative depth | Wolfram & Schein 2025 | conceptual (bin agreement instead of nearest-neighbour overlap) | depth-match Spearman median 0.95 (range 0.59-1.00); >= 0.9 in 13/21 pairs | partly replicated |
| R-e | A few dimensions carry massive activations in LLMs | Sun et al. 2024 | conceptual (variance share of mean-pooled features) | max top-5 variance share: qwen3_17b 1.00, qwen35_2b 0.05, smollm2_17b 1.00, gemma4_e2b 0.16, qwen35_4b 0.14 | replicated in 2 of 5 models; extends to Qwen3-1.7B and SmolLM2-1.7B |
| R-f | Hubness marks documents that retrieve poorly | Radovanović et al. 2010 | conceptual (k-occurrence vs a document's own p@10 failure) | hubness AUROC for failure 0.57-0.64 across 11 pairs | replicated (it was the best of four signals) |
| R-g | In left-to-right LMs, current-token information falls with depth and next-token information rises | Voita, Sennrich & Titov 2019 | direct in spirit (k-means bins of token states, NMI) | Gemma: identity 0.80 -> 0.58, next-word peak at layer 24 of 35; Qwen3: identity drop 0.30, next-word peak at layer 28 (last) | partly replicated: identity falls in both; next-word information peaks at the last layer in Qwen3 but at layer 24 of 35 in Gemma, and never overtakes identity in either |
| R-h | Layers with lower intrinsic dimension carry more semantic structure | Valeriani et al. 2023 | conceptual (TwoNN on pooled documents as a layer picker) | dev regret: lowest-ID 3.5 vs highest-ID 24.1 points | consistent: lowest-ID was the better direction and the strongest rival selector; disagrees with Cheng et al. 2025 (token level) |
